## Page and section

Link the page and heading, or describe what you were trying to find.

## Problem

Explain what is unclear, stale, duplicated, broken, or contradicted elsewhere.

## Verified behavior

If the problem concerns a command or example, include the environment, command, and result. Remove credentials and private paths.

## Suggested outcome

What should a reader understand or be able to do after the fix? Please separate current behavior from limitations and future ideas.
